result.question: What happened to the seven sons of Sceva?

readings.answer: They ran out of the house naked and wounded.
readings.support: they ran out of the house naked and wounded.

readings.answer: They were overpowered by the man with the evil spirit.
readings.support: the man with the evil spirit jumped on them and overpowered them all.

readings.answer: They were attacked by the man with the evil spirit.
readings.support: the man with the evil spirit jumped on them

readings.answer: They were asked who they were by the evil spirit.
readings.support: the evil spirit responded, | but who are you?

assessments.reason: Verse 19:16 explicitly says they “ran out of the house naked and wounded,” which is a correct (though partial) statement of what happened to them.
Verse 19:16 says the man with the evil spirit “overpowered them all,” matching this part of the keyed outcome though omitting the flight and injuries.
Verse 19:16 says the man “jumped on them,” which is an attack; this is a true but incomplete description of what happened.

Verse 19:15 records the spirit’s question (“but who are you?”), which is speech, not the event that happened to the sons; the passage then specifies the actual outcome as being overpowered and fleeing naked and wounded.
